sketch:
Observe (read): short primer with an SVG solar-system schematic
(log-scaled radii toggle for legibility) and a zoom-out sequence
through orders of magnitude (Earth → Solar System → Milky Way →
Local Group). Scale-bar HUD in AU / ly. No numeric target-matching —
just reading, scrubbing a time slider to see planetary revolutions,
and toggling the seasons demo (Earth's tilted axis + moving subsolar
point). Evaluate: 5 concept cards on distances, seasons, night/day,
relative sizes, and where Earth sits in the Milky Way. No Experiment
stage — order-of-magnitude astronomy at 1ère depth is descriptive,
not simulate-able.
